description: Scan the imported parcel + 10 m margin via ULDK and add discovered building footprints as `building` zones. Requires `import_parcel` first — uses the current parcel and geo-anchor. Blocks until the scan completes; **typically 1–2 minutes for a residential parcel** because ULDK is slow, so do not retry on perceived stalls. Re-runs are safe: buildings already imported are deduped by `parcelBuildingId` and reported under `skipped`. Returns `{ success, count, added, skipped, buildings: [{ zoneId, parcelBuildingId, functionLabel, centerX, centerY, width, height }] }` (meters). The largest building whose center sits inside the parcel is usually the user's house; the rest are neighbors. Poland only: refused for a garden placed outside Poland.
name: import_buildings
